title: Guanidine-based DNA extraction with silica-coated beads or silica spin columns
author: Dominik Buchner

steps.title: Centrifuge lysates
steps.instruction: Spin cleared lysates at 11,000 × g, 20 °C for 3 min.

steps.title: Prepare binding mixture
steps.instruction: In a 1.2 mL square‑well plate add 240 µL DNA binding buffer and 20 µL Serasil 400 beads per sample.

steps.title: Add lysate to binding mix
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL cleared lysate to each well (lysate volume may vary; adjust binding‑buffer volume to 2 × (lysate + 20 µL beads) to keep the lysate + beads to binding‑buffer ratio constant).

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate plate at room temperature, 700 rpm for 5 min to allow DNA binding.

steps.title: Magnetically pellet beads
steps.instruction: Place plate on magnetic stand for 2 min (adjust time if needed).

steps.title: Wash beads (first)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL wash buffer to each well.

steps.title: Mix wash
steps.instruction: Shake at 1000 rpm, room temperature for 1 min to remove excess salt.

steps.title: Pellet beads (second)
steps.instruction: Place plate on magnet for 1 min.

steps.title: Dry ethanol residue
steps.instruction: Incubate plate at 50 °C for 5 min to evaporate residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer to each well; incubate at room temperature, 1000 rpm for 5 min (pre‑warming elution buffer or incubating at 50 °C may increase yield).

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Place plate on magnet for 2 min, then transfer 95 µL eluate to a new PCR plate; leave 5 µL to avoid bead carry‑over and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare column binding mix
steps.instruction: Combine 400 µL DNA binding buffer with 200 µL cleared lysate (maintain 2:1 buffer:lysate ratio) and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Load onto spin column
steps.instruction: Apply the entire mixture to a silica spin column; centrifuge at 11,000 × g, room temperature for 1 min to bind DNA, discard flow‑through. If volume exceeds column bed, load in multiple aliquots.

steps.title: Wash column (first)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL wash buffer to the column; centrifuge at 11,000 × g, room temperature for 30 s; discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash step with another 600 µL wash buffer under the same centrifugation conditions.

steps.title: Dry membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 × g, room temperature for 1 min to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Transfer column to tube
steps.instruction: Discard the collection tube and place the spin column into a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer directly onto the silica membrane; incubate at room temperature for 3 min (pre‑warming to 50 °C may improve yield).

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 × g, room temperature for 1 min; discard the spin column and store the eluate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare vacuum binding mix
steps.instruction: Combine 400 µL DNA binding buffer with 200 µL cleared lysate, vortex briefly (maintain 2:1 ratio).

steps.title: Load onto filter plate
steps.instruction: Load the mixture onto a silica spin column or 96‑well filter plate placed in a vacuum manifold; apply vacuum until all liquid passes (≈2 min), then release vacuum. If volume exceeds bed capacity, load in multiple aliquots; unclog any blocked well with a sterile pipette tip without piercing the membrane.

steps.title: Wash filter plate (first)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL wash buffer to each well; apply vacuum until buffer passes (≈1 min), then release vacuum.

steps.title: Wash filter plate (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash step with another 600 µL wash buffer under the same vacuum conditions.

steps.title: Dry membrane (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Apply vacuum for 10 min to completely dry the silica membrane; if residual wash remains, dry at 50 °C for 5 min on a heat block stacked inside a 1.2 mL storage plate.

steps.title: Prepare collection plate
steps.instruction: Place an appropriate collection plate in the vacuum manifold (1.2 mL or 2.2 mL storage plate for large volumes; 96‑well PCR or U‑bottom plate for smaller volumes).

steps.title: Elute DNA (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer directly onto the silica membrane; apply vacuum until eluate passes (≈1 min); store eluate at –20 °C (pre‑warming buffer to 50 °C may increase yield).
